notes:
Better Next episode timing, and separate intro/outro skipping.

Next episode no longer appears the moment the credits start. It used to show as soon as an outro was detected, which on a 24-minute episode with credits from 21:30 meant the button sat on screen for the last two and a half minutes. It now waits until the credits actually finish, so it means "this episode is done" rather than "an outro was found".

Auto-skip intro and Auto-skip outro are now two separate settings under Playback. Your existing preference carries over to both, and from then on they are independent, so you can skip openings while letting the closing credits play. Turning auto-skip outro on skips the credits and offers the next episode straight away; leaving it off plays them out and offers the next episode as they end. If credits are left playing you also get a Skip button again, which the old timing had hidden.

The next episode is now quietly prepared as soon as the credits begin, instead of only once the button appeared, so continuing has less of a wait. Episodes with no credit information behave as before.
